about: The Haftarah from the Prophets begins with God saying, “I have loved Jacob.” He chose Jacob, the twin born in this week’s portion. The reading from the Apostles reminds us to set our hearts on heavenly things. Esau did the opposite when he traded his birthright for a bowl of stew.
note: The Prophet Zechariah received a prophecy about fasting the right way (see Zechariah 7:1–14). “In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev” (NIV).
prompts: How does the Haftarah connect to this week's Torah Portion?
How do the Apostles connect to this week's Torah Portion?
